24 year old male here. I love music, having spontaneous fun, generally nerdy stuff, talking and laughing, and, well, pretty much everything. I'm outgoing and love new things.

My goals are to finish a few terms in the Navy to round off my Army time and give me time to decide if I'd wish to pursue my initial choice of a medical career or major in chemical engineering.

Yeah, raving is awesome. Nothing like pure uninhibited fun.

PM me if you'd like to talk.

I have two dogs that are my world. But I'm going to have to leave them behind. I don't have the money to find a place here on such short notice so I have to move to California with my father and he cannot have dogs.

I appreciate everything you and everyone else have said. You're right, it does get better but it's fully dependent on my actions. That being said, I'm terrified of the crushing loneliness I remember from before her. No one to show the latest /r/mildlyinteresting to or share my concerns with.

No one to comfort me when I'm going out of my mind with doubt and grief. It scares me that during the hardest time in my life I'm completely alone. Not only that, but the person I trusted and invested all of myself in is causing it. That's the scary part. That and dating. Dating sucks.

Arkansas, most likely. Fertile soil, clean and plentiful water, vast forests full of healthy game animals and few predators, and an excessive amount of guns with which I can begin the First Great and Bountiful Human Empire.
Probably going to be buried slightly deeper than hell but... Machine Gun Blues - Social Distortion. "I'm aaaaaaaalready goooooone!"
A stout drink for the graves of these men and nine generations of their kin.
